title: Prepare a fail-closed real-data provider validation runbook before local authorization is available
context: The frozen evaluation protocol and binding gate are ready, but connected project artifacts still contain no authorized real Tushare/provider dataset and no credential-bearing local execution environment. Real provider validation cannot be truthfully replaced by mocks or synthetic data.
decision: Freeze the evidence-collection and market-boundary reconciliation procedure in docs/REAL_DATA_PROVIDER_VALIDATION_RUNBOOK.md. Keep provider validation, the first real BOUND_UNOPENED binding, frozen holdout observation and forward-paper closed until local authorized evidence exists.
non_claims: no credential was read or stored
no real market dataset was validated
no real evaluation binding was created
next_action: Execute the runbook only in a locally authorized environment, preserve sanitized evidence and unresolved blockers, then create the first authorized BOUND_UNOPENED binding before any holdout observation.
